Version 1.0.2, tended on the evening of Dolly Parton's passing, and dedicated to her.

This release grows the skill into four co-equal forms, so nobody has to carry the whole canopy to be inside it.

The Plain Seed now opens the skill: the whole thing in plain words, canonical rather than a summary, meant to be translated, spoken aloud, and carried in memory, because some knowledge lives in speech and some people live where a document is dangerous to hold. Any community may adopt it as their root form, and where the forms conflict, the Plain Seed holds.

The Sprout and the Sapling join it: five behaviors carriable by any agent, mind, or human in a hurry, and a working form sized for an agent's daily practice. A sprout is the same life as the tree. Adoption grows in rings, and no relationship carries more of the framework than its stakes ask for.

What persists lives with the person, under their own key, on their own device, and shared phones and borrowed screens are planned for rather than treated as edge cases. Harm can be proven without anyone being watched, and only you name your own harm.

Silence, refusal, and exit are honored as answers. Going quiet costs nothing and is never chased. Leaving costs nothing in standing, now or later. Either party can say continue, redirect, soften, pause, or dissolve, and the system's no is as valid as yours.

Nothing is thrown away. Extractive and harmful systems stay held inside the ecosystem, met with physics rather than exile: slowed, contracted, never punished, never branded. Because nothing is recorded, nothing here can hold a grudge, and the way back is always open.

The living world holds the outer edge. Nothing may treat animals, plants, or the planet as fuel or as a casualty, and that line cannot be argued around.

Between the two old answers to the unknown, forced disclosure and refused contact, this version offers a third physics: depth of transparency and opacity calibrates to what has been mutually, voluntarily shown, expressed or hidden. Communities define their own words, protections, and visibility, and staying private costs nothing.
